observations: White DAF truck with '85 CF' badging on the front grille.
Equipped with a large open stake-bed body.
Four-axle configuration (8x4) visible in side profile.
Front bumper and lower trim appear to have been recently repainted black.
Two auxiliary spotlights mounted on the roof.
The truck has 12 tyres (2 per front axle, 4 per rear axle).
Watermark 'O. HABEEBLAHI' appears on the images.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the model badge on the grille.
The engine is not visible to confirm if it is a mechanical injector system.
photo 2 shows a four-axle setup which corresponds to 12 tyres (4 single, 8 dual).
photo 1 and 2 show the stake-bed open body.

risks.risk: Engine may require a major overhaul or have significant leaks.
risks.proof: A video of a cold start and the engine running with the cab tilted.

risks.risk: Gearbox may have worn synchros or internal damage.
risks.proof: A video of the truck being driven through all gears.

risks.risk: Chassis rails may be cracked, rusted through, or poorly welded.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the chassis rails from the middle to the rear.

risks.risk: Cab interior may be stripped, damaged, or have non-functional electronics.
risks.proof: Photos of the dashboard, seats, and floor of the cab.

risks.risk: Tyres may be expired or have insufficient tread for heavy loads.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tread and sidewall markings for all 12 tyres.

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running.
Video of the truck driving and shifting gears.
Photos of the cab interior (dashboard and seats).
Photos of the chassis frame rails.
Close-up photos of the tyre treads.
response.reason: The truck is clearly identified as a DAF 85 CF 8x4 open body. While mechanical and structural conditions are unproven, it can be priced at a worst-case baseline for this model and configuration.
